title: Drop the numpy requirement
body:
### Outline & Motivation

We barely use `numpy`. We should replace its uses with torch.

Reduce the package footprint

### Pitch

Remove https://github.com/Lightning-AI/lightning/blob/7bbbe22636853e1ee6fa57b557b3408d45233589/requirements/pytorch/base.txt#L4

Update numpy usages with torch.

### Additional context

_No response_

cc @participant10 @participant11 @participant2

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: I think there was some cross-dependency, leaking `numpy` typing which was changed in the frozen version but lets see if all is fine now :)

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
We had a strong dependency on numpy for working with jagged arrays when [post-processing the various output formats for the epoch_end hooks](https://github.com/Lightning-AI/lightning/blob/fc195b95405e9e2629466e5b28c6a9243209d596/src/pytorch_lightning/loops/epoch/training_epoch_loop.py#L361).
Since this was removed, we have a weaker dependency now.
One notable usage though is in the seeding: https://github.com/Lightning-AI/lightning/blob/7bbbe22636853e1ee6fa57b557b3408d45233589/src/lightning/fabric/utilities/seed.py#L96-L101

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
There's this issue on PyTorch to include the SeedSequence API: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/56805, but as a workaround, they added https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/56797
The relevant discussion is at https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/56488/files#r619435608

This PR can be done in pieces, we don't need to replace all usages concurrently.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
Hi 
Sorry for the late reply here, I've been busy with other things, but I've seen some activity here and wanted to clarify a few things.

1. The motivation of this issue is to drop the numpy requirement, but to be more precise what that means is making the numpy depencency _no longer a required dependency_. There are places in the code where we handle numpy, and these need to stay. What that means for this issue is that these places need to be guarded by a check whether numpy is available. If it is not, we do nothing. If it is available, we do what we used to do. The relevant places where this applies are:

	- [x] [Seeding the random state](https://github.com/Lightning-AI/pytorch-lightning/blob/90f23b34e956ac19eda4f5b41b9d1339595fd207/src/lightning/fabric/utilities/seed.py#L57)
	- [x] [Worker seed initializtion](https://github.com/Lightning-AI/pytorch-lightning/blob/90f23b34e956ac19eda4f5b41b9d1339595fd207/src/lightning/fabric/utilities/seed.py#L78)
	- [x] [Collection of numpy rng state](https://github.com/Lightning-AI/pytorch-lightning/blob/90f23b34e956ac19eda4f5b41b9d1339595fd207/src/lightning/fabric/utilities/seed.py#L105-L111)
	- [x] [Restoration of numpy state](https://github.com/Lightning-AI/pytorch-lightning/blob/90f23b34e956ac19eda4f5b41b9d1339595fd207/src/lightning/fabric/utilities/seed.py#L117-L124) 
	- [x] [Conversion dtypes](https://github.com/Lightning-AI/pytorch-lightning/blob/90f23b34e956ac19eda4f5b41b9d1339595fd207/src/lightning/fabric/utilities/apply_func.py#L30-L40)
	- [x] [Parameter sanitization](https://github.com/Lightning-AI/pytorch-lightning/blob/90f23b34e956ac19eda4f5b41b9d1339595fd207/src/lightning/fabric/utilities/logger.py#L133-L134)

	These are all occurrences where we don't want to (and can't) replace numpy with torch. What we would do there is simply do a check whether numpy is available, like so:

	```py
	from lightning_utilities.core.imports import RequirementCache
	
	_NUMPY_AVAILABLE = RequirementCache("numpy")
	
	if _NUMPY_AVAILABLE:
	     # execute special numpy code
	else:
	     # do nothing
	
	```
	
	**Contributions for these are welcome, please start with these if you are interested.**


2. Should we also remove the numpy from tests? The answer is no. Tests are not shipped as part of the package, and numpy is useful in our tests for various reasons. We should keep numpy as a testing requirement

3. This issue does not apply to src/lightning/app. In fact, that code will soon be removed from the repository anyway. @participant9 I've seen you've opened a PR for examples/app, but the timing for this unfortunate because we plan to remove the app code in the next day or so. Maybe you'd like to take one of the above items I've listed instead?

Thanks everyone for the willingness to contribute. I hope the directions above make it a bit clearer what should be done as the next step.
